title: Smaller than expected, but okay
text:
Smaller than expected, but okay. The largest one was smaller than I had expected. (Yes, the measurements are in this listing, but were not available on the listing from which I purchased these.) However, these should work fine for why I wanted them - to cut shapes from biscuits and sandwiches.

I have to say, the ones we received were not a beautiful, shiny silver like the ones in the photo. Ours are dull, and almost look unfinished. One had a crooked seam.
I am sure they will work out okay. I was just disappointed that they were not the shiny finish in the product photo.
